title: Seattle Paragliding
specs: Flights from Poo Poo Point with views of Mount Rainier, Mount Si, Lake Sammamish, Bellevue, Seattle, and Puget Sound
Fly with bald eagles and other birds riding thermals
Over 35 years of experience; team built trail to Poo Poo Point
No minimum age requirements; passengers flown from 5 to 94 years old
Do not drink alcohol 12 hours before flying
If motion sensitive, refrain from eating 3 hours before flying and consider taking Dramamine
12 instructors available; can accommodate large groups with up to 12 clients flying simultaneously

services.name: Tandem flights
services.desc: Plan on spending 2.5 hours once you arrive at Seattle Paragliding to go through orientation, complete release form, get up the mountain, fly, and enjoy watching your video after your flight on our big screen TVs in the barn. Seattle Paragliding is located at 11206 Issaquah-Hobart Rd SE in Issaquah. When you arrive, you can park your vehicle in front or behind the office building (pictured above), if space is available. If parking is not available at Seattle Paragliding or at the Tiger Mountain landing zone, there is paid parking ($5 cash) across the street. Please give yourself ample time to find parking so that you will be on time for your orientation. Once at the Seattle Paragliding

blurb: Guests experience tandem paragliding flights from Poo Poo Point on Tiger Mountain with views of Mount Rainier, Mount Si, Lake Sammamish, Bellevue, Seattle, and Puget Sound. Flights include running down a grassy hill to become airborne, sitting in a reclined harness with feet dangling. Flights can include in-flight HD GoPro video for an extra fee.
extraNote: Cancellation or reschedule allowed with refund if notified at least 24 hours before scheduled time · Seattle Paragliding facility at 11206 Issaquah-Hobart Rd SE in Issaquah
